name: continued-browser
description: Continued for the browser: a local-first AI agent in your Chrome side panel or Firefox sidebar, with a harness builder.

scripts.zip: node build.mjs && rm -f continued-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip continued-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip && (cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../../continued-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip .) && (cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../../continued-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip .) && echo built continued-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip continued-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.source-zip: rm -f continued-source-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -qr continued-source-$npm_package_version.zip package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json build.mjs manifest.json README.md PUBLISHING.md src && echo built continued-source-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.chrome: echo 'Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, Load unpacked -> browser-plugin/dist/chrome'
